title: $1.75 Billion Gone in 6 Months #shorts
description:
Quibi raised one point seven five billion dollars from Hollywood and investors for a phone-only streaming app. Six months after launch, it announced it was shutting down.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
first_comment: Bad idea, or just terrible timing? Would Quibi have survived without the pandemic? 👇

lines.text: One point seven five billion dollars, gone in six months.
How do you burn that much that fast?
Quibi was a streaming app for phones, backed by Hollywood's biggest names.
It raised one point seven five billion dollars before launch.
Ten-minute shows, made only for your phone.
It launched in April twenty twenty. Right as the world stayed home.
Nobody was on the go. And it couldn't play on your TV.
Six months after launch, Quibi announced it was shutting down.
One point seven five billion dollars, for an app that lasted six months.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
